meta.name: Only For Singles
meta.description:
Story of six single individuals who shift to Bombay and are struggling not just to settle down in the new city but also find out the right jobs for them. The single status has embarked upon as a big challenge in their lives and they seemed to be fighting a lot about it.

The show is a very light-hearted comedy with its smooth flowing storyline about six single people trying to make it on their own in Mumbai, all the while tackling their own set of problems that are common to almost every millennial. From finding a place to live, to earning the respect of their parents while struggling to make ends meet in their dream career path, these six people and their antics give rise to some very comic moments.

Returning Series · First aired 27 Jun 2019 · Language: English

videos.title: Welcome to Ranjeeta Building!
videos.overview: The first episode of the show introduces all the six individuals and briefs about their lives.

videos.title: Love Aur Doosre Drugs
videos.overview: As the six singles start living together, Ranjeeta aka RJ throws a part to welcome herself into the house. Rapchik Rani and Riyal go to get drugs. Mickey notices RJ still reeling over the issue with her father, so asks her to move on. But things go out of hand when the party goes wilder and an old man living in the neighborhood

videos.title: Wifi Hai Police Station Mein?
videos.overview: After the wild party in the previous episode, it is revealed that the old man is Subbu who is their sinister neighbor. He calls the police and gets the whole gang arrested.

videos.title: Commitment Kar Di Toh Kar Di!
videos.overview: Another problem arises when RJ has to come up with a whopping amount of ten lakh rupees. Why does she need the money?

videos.title: Harman Ki Jabra Mardaangi
videos.overview: Harman gets happy when he gets the call for an underwear ad, but the one big requirement is a big “package”.

videos.title: Phass gaya Mickey!
videos.overview: Mickey is stuck between RJ and Appu as he tries to keep both of them happy.

videos.title: Jingle Mingle For Singles
videos.overview: As Riyaz faces further problems in his job, Appu, who is a lawyer, makes a grand entry to his restaurant and threatens his boss to sue him only grounds of discrimination.

videos.title: Riyaz ke Wet Dreams
videos.overview: Rapchik’s idea of organizing the singles night turns out to be a big flop. And meanwhile, Riyaz is scared of the fact that he is falling in love with Appu.

videos.title: Khoon Paseena Aur Haseena
videos.overview: The episode starts with RJ revealing to everyone that Mickey has paid the money by borrowing from his father. This does not go well with Appu as she gets deeply affected.

videos.title: Desi Spiderman
videos.overview: Harman climbs up the building named Ranjeeta, to perform his deadly stunt.

videos.title: Ghar Dhoondhe, Phir Ghar Dhoodhe!
videos.overview: The episode starts with the introduction of Mrinal Awasty, who is a businesswoman and had a fall out with RJ’s father, KRK. In order to exact her revenge, she kicks the singles out of the building with the help of Subbu

videos.title: Alvida, Mumbai!
videos.overview: After the completion of their fight with some local goons, the gang looks depressed and defeated because of the situation. Rapchik then decides to give up her dream of becoming an online star.
